tasks.name: Prepare the project execution plan
tasks.description: Write and update the execution plan: scope, organisation, phase plan, work split, gate criteria and key procedures.

needs.info: Business case, capacity, product slate, target start-up date, funding gates and owner organisation and approval roles
Owner project standards and procedures list (document, cost, schedule, HSE reporting requirements)
Construction strategy: direct hire vs subcontract, modularisation intent, site access and workforce assumptions

tasks.name: Develop the contracting and procurement strategy
tasks.description: Define contract packages, procurement packages, split of owner-furnished and contractor-furnished items and the long-lead strategy.

needs.info: Preliminary equipment list with equipment types, counts and package boundaries
Long-lead and critical equipment identification (heaters, columns, compressors, large exchangers) with indicative lead times
Market lead times, vendor capacity and approved vendor coverage per commodity
Construction contract packages (civil, mechanical, E&I) and module/pre-assembly split

tasks.name: Set up the WBS, cost codes and P6 project structure
tasks.description: Build the work breakdown structure, area and unit codes, cost codes and P6 calendars and activity codes used by all disciplines.

needs.info: Plot plan areas and unit boundaries for area codes
Construction work area (CWA) breakdown for AWP
Owner cost reporting structure and AFE/capital codes

tasks.name: Set up document numbering and the Document Locator project
tasks.description: Issue the numbering procedure, document type and discipline codes, folder structure, workflows and distribution matrix in Document Locator.

needs.info: Owner document numbering standard, revision conventions and required metadata for handover
WBS area and unit codes (PROJ-T030)

tasks.name: Compile and maintain the deliverables register
tasks.description: Collect each discipline's deliverables list, assign document numbers and keep the register with planned and actual issue dates and revisions.

needs.info: Process deliverables list: titles, document types, quantity of sheets, planned IFR/IFD/IFC dates
Safety study deliverables list with planned workshop and report dates
Mechanical deliverables list: datasheets, calculations, requisitions per equipment item
Piping deliverables list including isometric counts by area and drawing types
Civil/structural deliverables list: foundations, steel, buildings drawings per area
Instrumentation deliverables list: index, datasheets, loops, C&E, layouts
Electrical deliverables list: SLDs, studies, cable schedule, layouts
Document numbering procedure and codes (PROJ-T040)

tasks.name: Prepare the Class 5 estimate
tasks.description: Build the capacity-factored or curve-based order-of-magnitude estimate for the business case.

needs.info: Capacity, product slate, site location and economic assumptions (escalation, currency)
Block flow diagram with unit capacities and configuration option
Historical cost data and capacity factors from reference projects

tasks.name: Issue estimate quantity requests to disciplines
tasks.description: Send each discipline the quantity take-off template, basis and due dates for the estimate.

needs.info: Estimate basis: estimate class, accuracy, codes and cut-off date (PROJ-T030)

tasks.name: Prepare the Class 4 estimate
tasks.description: Equipment-factored estimate from the equipment list, budget quotes and factored bulks.

needs.info: Equipment list with type, size, design P/T, material and duty for each item
Equipment weights and material class for pricing; budget pricing requests issued
Budget quotations for major equipment: price, delivery, scope inclusions
Factored piping quantities by area (tonnage or length by size range)
Site preparation, earthwork and foundation allowances; building sizes
Electrical load summary and main equipment (transformers, switchgear) count
Instrument count by type and control system I/O estimate
Labour rates, productivity factors and indirects

tasks.name: Prepare the Class 3 estimate
tasks.description: Semi-detailed estimate from vendor quotes and discipline MTOs priced with unit rates.

needs.info: Firm or budget bid prices for major equipment and packages from bid tabulations
Piping MTO by commodity code and size: pipe length, fittings, valves, supports, estimated weld count
Concrete volumes, piling counts, structural steel tonnage, building areas
Cable lengths by type, raceway quantities, electrical equipment list
Instrument index counts by type, cable quantities, control system I/O count
Construction labour hours, indirects, temporary facilities and heavy lift costs
Fire protection systems and environmental mitigation scope

tasks.name: Prepare the control estimate and budget
tasks.description: Re-base the approved estimate into the control budget by WBS and cost code for cost tracking.

needs.info: Approved Class 3 estimate and gate approval (PROJ-T090, PROJ-T170)
Committed PO values by package from award
Approved AFE value and contingency release rules

tasks.name: Build and baseline the integrated schedule in P6
tasks.description: Build the level 2/3 schedule linking engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning and set the baseline.

needs.info: Deliverables register with document numbers and types (PROJ-T050)
Procurement schedule per MR: RFQ, bid, award, vendor data and delivery durations
Path of construction, CWP sequence and durations
System completion and startup sequence with priority systems
Vendor data needs: which vendor data gates which engineering deliverables

tasks.name: Integrate procurement and vendor dates into the schedule
tasks.description: Update P6 with PO award dates, vendor drawing return dates and forecast delivery dates from the Purchasing DB.

needs.info: PO award dates and contractual delivery dates per PO line
Expediting forecast delivery and ex-works dates per PO line
Vendor print status: due and received dates for vendor drawings per VDRL item

tasks.name: Measure engineering progress
tasks.description: Collect deliverable progress by rules of credit, compute earned value and update P6.

needs.info: Deliverables register with actual issue dates and revision status (PROJ-T050)
Percent complete per process deliverable against step rules
Model progress and isometric counts issued vs planned
Datasheet and requisition progress
Instrument datasheet and loop diagram completion counts
Electrical deliverable completion counts
Foundation and steel drawing completion counts
Safety study completion and action close-out counts

tasks.name: Update the schedule and analyse the critical path
tasks.description: Statusing, critical path and float analysis, look-ahead and recovery proposals.

needs.info: Engineering progress and earned value (PROJ-T130)
Procurement and vendor forecast dates (PROJ-T120)
Construction progress: installed quantities by CWP and look-ahead
ITR completion and system turnover progress

tasks.name: Track cost and forecast at completion
tasks.description: Track commitments, actuals and forecasts against the control budget and issue the cost report.

needs.info: Committed cost per PO and PO amendment with cost codes
Actual invoices paid from owner finance system
Field labour hours and subcontract progress claims
Approved change orders and trends (PROJ-T160)

tasks.name: Run change control: trends and change notices
tasks.description: Log trends raised by any discipline, estimate cost and schedule impact, and take change notices to approval.

needs.info: Scope or design basis changes with description and affected deliverables
Equipment changes and vendor price/schedule impacts
Rework estimates (isometrics, model) from design changes
Field changes and RFIs with cost and schedule impact
Vendor change order prices and delivery impact
Owner-requested scope changes and change approvals

tasks.name: Prepare gate review packages and record gate decisions
tasks.description: Assemble the deliverables, estimate, schedule and risk for each gate and record the owner's decision.

needs.info: Design basis, PFDs, H&MB and process design report at gate maturity
HAZID/HAZOP reports, siting study and open safety actions
Estimate of current class, schedule and risk register (PROJ-T080/T090, T110, T180)
Gate criteria and decision

tasks.name: Maintain the risk register and contingency analysis
tasks.description: Run risk workshops, maintain the register and run cost and schedule risk analysis to set contingency.

needs.info: Technical risks: feed variability, technology, design basis uncertainty
HSE and permitting risks and their schedule exposure
Supply chain risks: lead time, single source, logistics and tariff risk
Construction risks: weather, productivity, labour availability
Estimate and schedule (PROJ-T090, PROJ-T110)

tasks.name: Run interface management
tasks.description: Keep the interface register between disciplines, contractors, vendors and owner and chase interface agreements to closure.

needs.info: Tie-in list and battery-limit interface points with existing facilities
Existing facility data and owner interface contacts; operating constraints at tie-ins
Package battery-limit interface data (nozzles, terminal points, utilities)
Contractor interface points between construction packages

tasks.name: Issue documents by transmittal
tasks.description: Check issued documents for numbering and metadata and transmit them to owner, vendors and construction per the distribution matrix.

needs.info: Documents released for issue with revision and issue purpose
Documents released for issue with revision and issue purpose
Isometrics and drawings released for issue with revision and issue purpose
Documents released for issue with revision and issue purpose
Documents released for issue with revision and issue purpose
Documents released for issue with revision and issue purpose
Distribution matrix (PROJ-T040)

tasks.name: Run review cycles and consolidate comments
tasks.description: Route documents for owner and inter-discipline review, collect and consolidate comments and return them with review status.

needs.info: Owner review comments and approval code per document
Safety review comments on P&IDs, layouts and specifications
Constructability review comments
Transmittals issued with review due dates (PROJ-T200)

tasks.name: Maintain the hold list
tasks.description: Track holds on drawings and documents with their cause, owner and target release date.

needs.info: Holds on isometrics and layouts with reason (vendor data, stress, HAZOP)
Holds on foundation drawings awaiting certified vendor loads
Vendor data outstanding that holds downstream drawings
Holds on loops and datasheets awaiting vendor data
Vendor print status: overdue vendor documents

tasks.name: Track IFC issue and PE seal status
tasks.description: Confirm each document is checked, approved and sealed before IFC release and record the seal status.

needs.info: Engineer of record approval and seal for IFC documents
Sealed foundation and structural drawings
Sealed electrical drawings
Hold list status cleared (PROJ-T220)

tasks.name: Prepare monthly progress reports
tasks.description: Compile progress, cost, schedule, change, risk, procurement and HSE status into the owner report.

needs.info: Schedule update, cost report, change and risk registers (PROJ-T140, T150, T160, T180)
Procurement status report: MRs, POs placed, expediting exceptions
Construction progress and HSE statistics
Completions progress: ITRs, punch, systems turned over

tasks.name: Load construction progress into P6
tasks.description: Load installed quantities and CWP/IWP completion from the field into P6 for earned value.

needs.info: Installed quantities by CWP/IWP and commodity from field progress tracking
Material availability status per IWP from Jovix

tasks.name: Compile the final records and close out
tasks.description: Assemble as-built documents, vendor data books and the final records index for handover to the owner and close the project.

needs.info: As-built redlines incorporated and as-built drawing list
Final MDR/data books per PO
Turnover packages and handover certificates
PO close-out status and spare parts handover
Handover acceptance and records format requirements

items.name: Project execution plan
items.content: Scope, organisation, phase plan, work split, gate criteria, key procedures, reporting requirements.

items.name: Contracting and procurement strategy
items.content: Contract packages, procurement packages, owner/contractor-furnished split, long-lead items to commit early, approved commercial terms.

items.name: WBS, area codes and cost codes
items.content: WBS levels, area and unit codes, cost codes, P6 activity codes and calendars.

items.name: Document numbering procedure and codes
items.content: Numbering format, discipline, document type and area codes, revision and issue-purpose conventions, required metadata.

items.name: Document Locator structure and distribution matrix
items.content: Folder structure, review workflows, distribution matrix by document type and recipient (owner, vendor, construction).

items.name: Deliverables register
items.content: Document number, title, discipline, type, planned and actual IFR/IFD/IFC dates, current revision and status.

items.name: Assigned document numbers
items.content: Document numbers reserved for each discipline's new deliverables, including vendor document numbers per PO.

items.name: Estimate quantity request
items.content: Quantity take-off template per discipline, estimate class, basis, code of accounts and due date.

items.name: Class 5 estimate
items.content: Order-of-magnitude capital cost by unit, accuracy range, basis and exclusions.

items.name: Class 4 estimate
items.content: Equipment-factored cost by area and code of accounts, contingency, basis of estimate.

items.name: Class 3 estimate
items.content: Detailed cost by WBS and commodity, unit rates, labour hours, indirects, contingency, basis of estimate.

items.name: Control budget
items.content: Budget by WBS and cost code, contingency and management reserve.

items.name: Baseline integrated schedule
items.content: Level 2/3 activities, logic, durations and baseline dates for engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.

items.name: Deliverable schedule dates
items.content: Planned IFR/IFD/IFC dates per deliverable sent to each discipline lead.

items.name: Required-on-site and need dates per MR
items.content: Required-on-site (ROS) date per MR and equipment tag, MR issue need date, PO award need date.

items.name: Procurement and vendor dates in P6
items.content: PO award, vendor data return and forecast delivery dates linked to engineering and construction activities.

items.name: Engineering progress and earned value
items.content: Percent complete per deliverable and discipline, earned hours, SPI/CPI.

items.name: Schedule update and critical path report
items.content: Updated dates, critical and near-critical paths, float, look-ahead and recovery actions.

items.name: Cost report and forecast
items.content: Budget, commitments, actuals, estimate to complete and forecast at completion by WBS.

items.name: Trend register
items.content: Trend number, description, originator, rough cost and schedule impact, status.

items.name: Approved change notice
items.content: Change number, scope description, affected deliverables and POs, approved cost and schedule adjustment.

items.name: Gate review package
items.content: Deliverables, estimate, schedule, risk and readiness checklist for the gate.

items.name: Gate decision
items.content: Owner decision to proceed, recycle or stop, with conditions and actions.

items.name: Risk register
items.content: Risk ID, description, owner, probability, impact, mitigation and status.

items.name: Contingency analysis result
items.content: P50/P90 cost and schedule results, recommended contingency and drivers.

items.name: Interface register
items.content: Interface ID, parties, description, required date, status and agreement reference.

items.name: Interface query and agreement
items.content: Request for interface data and the agreed response (terminal point, design values, responsibility).

items.name: Transmittal
items.content: Transmittal number, recipient, documents and revisions, issue purpose, review due date.

items.name: Consolidated comment sheet
items.content: Comments from all reviewers per document with commenter, reply and close-out.

items.name: Document review status
items.content: Review code per document revision (approved, approved with comments, rejected) and return date.

items.name: Hold list
items.content: Hold number, document, cause, responsible party, required information and target release date.

items.name: IFC release and seal record
items.content: Document, revision, checker, approver, seal holder and IFC release date.

items.name: Monthly progress report
items.content: Progress, cost, schedule, changes, risks, procurement and HSE status for the owner.

items.name: Construction progress in P6
items.content: Installed quantities and percent complete per CWP/IWP, earned hours.

items.name: Final records index
items.content: Final as-built document list, vendor data books and turnover records with locations for owner handover.

items.name: Project close-out report
items.content: Final cost, schedule, lessons learned and open items at close.
